collection.title: Mini Hatch 2004 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mini Cooper/One Hatchback 2001 - 2003 model requires a 18" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade, please note that due to the style of this blade the sizes recommended are 18" on both driver and passenger blade. This is because the windscreen on the Mini Cooper is quite curved and a 19" Retrofit blade will not fully match the windscreen. We also have the rear blade for this Cooper/One Hatchback, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
